## Added

- Native mod manager in the main menu and pause menu, plus the F6 shortcut.
- Bundled CursorMenu with mouse and keyboard control modes.
- ABI 1 C++ mod SDK, example mod, per-mod metadata and saved enabled states.

## Fixed

- The pause-menu Mods entry uses the game's font and preserves spacing between menu rows.
- Mouse input handles save/load menus and confirmation dialogs.
- Settings sliders use the game's own adjustment handlers.

## Compatibility

Windows x64; the specific GOG executable listed in the documentation. Arbitrary UE4SS mods and Hello Mod Kit maps are not automatically compatible.
